Illustration of the connection flow. Invite links are created inside DMC Player.

Starting a session

Send your friends an invite link.

  1. 1

    Open something to watch

    Choose a local file or direct HTTP/HTTPS stream your friends may access, or start a YouTube video. Everyone needs DMC Player 2.7 or later for YouTube.

  2. 2

    Start your session

    Choose Tools → Watch together, then press Host. Wait for your invite link.

  3. 3

    Share the invite

    Press Copy link and send it to friends. They open it with DMC Player or paste it into Join.

Your own player controls

Everyone gets a window that suits them.

Up to eight guests can join a host. Local video streams from the host, so friends don't need their own copy; the host needs enough upload capacity for each guest.

Everyone keeps their own volume, subtitles and window size. Hosting stops when the host ends the session or closes the player. The invitation grants access to that session, so send it only to the people you want to join.

Direct streams require each guest to be able to access the source. Subscription websites are not relayed or synchronised through Watch together.

YouTube with friends

Watch a YouTube video together.

From DMC Player 2.7, open a YouTube video, choose Tools → Watch together → Host and share the invite. Both players need version 2.7 or later.

The session synchronises play/pause, position and playback rate. Each person loads YouTube independently with their own access. Only the canonical public video URL, title and playback state are shared; extra URL parameters, cookies, account sessions and YouTube media bytes are not passed to friends.

Start an actual video before hosting. YouTube home, search and account pages cannot be hosted. Ads, loading, autoplay and region or account restrictions can delay playback; wait for ads to finish and press Play in YouTube if needed.

This supports YouTube video pages. Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ and other subscription websites are not relayed or synchronised.

Chat with your friends

Keep chatting while you watch.

Say something to the room without opening a big chat panel. In DMC Player 2.8, short chat messages appear over the picture, then fade after about six seconds.

  1. Open Chat in Watch together, or press Ctrl + Alt + C when the shortcut is available.
  2. Type and press Enter. Send up to 280 characters; Escape closes the composer.
  3. Keep watching. Up to three messages show at once. They do not take game focus or block clicks.

Both players need version 2.8 or later for chat. Turn off Show messages over video to hide the overlay on your own player.

Messages go to the host and connected room participants. There is no automatic saved transcript or earlier-chat replay; other people can still copy or record messages.

Chat and connection help ↗
60MIN

Free test relay

Try an internet session with your friends.

Automatic internet invites currently use a free test relay. Sessions last up to 60 minutes; start a new room to keep watching afterwards. Availability, speed and capacity are not guaranteed.

The host needs the Windows OpenSSH client. No relay account is required. Advanced direct connection remains available for a network, VPN or properly configured internet connection.
